notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b003:l012: Karagul says the trim or border of his bright coat will not separate when pulled; the boast’s exact implication is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b003:l013: Кызык бир жол алдадым says Karagul was deceived by a strange or remarkable road; the idiom is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b003:l019: Даңгыттарга жарат бейм is interpreted as Semetey making Karagul fit for, or presenting him to, the Danggits; the hostile idiom is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b003:l026: Айдай болгон чоң талаа compares the great plain to the moon, likely in breadth or roundness.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b005:l006: Жансыз чыдап турбаган states that no ordinary living creature can endure the plain; its literal negative construction is compressed.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b005:l014: The burning of ears and hooves is inferred from the elliptical lines about a moving creature and a wild ass stepping on the scorched desert.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b005:l019: Казгалдак is rendered as a goose or goose-like migratory bird; the exact species is uncertain.
notes.semetey-2-2013:p0033:b005:l032: Ирмегенин күчөтүп describes Buurul intensifying a surging or sweeping gait; the exact motion is uncertain.

transcription_check.details: Rendered Semetey volume 2 PDF page 33 at 1200-pixel scale and visually checked both printed columns against extracted coordinates and block structure. All 78 narrative positions are present in printed reading order, with 4 nonverse positions explicitly excluded. No independent manuscript collation.

alignment_check.details: Every extracted narrative row was paired in order with one directly translated English row. Repetitions, names, numbers, and page transitions were retained; material uncertainties are noted by source ID.

translation_provenance: Direct Kyrgyz-to-English draft from the extracted text and rendered source page. No prior English translation or external machine-translation output used. Same-agent visual and alignment checks only; no independent specialist review.
